correctness.rationale: Derive exact scalar seed renewal and both all-period Floquet characteristic formulas; they hold for every positive seasonal multiset and all allowed ages. A removable non-eigenvalue factor is excluded by exact reconstruction. At L=2 the trace gap is a positive square at equal determinant. At L=5 exact positive vectors give strict Perron bounds across one. Rational standalone tests reproduced the stated finite examples.
